chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 07 (Physical & Environmental Chemistry Focus)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: If $Q_c > K_c$, which statement correctly predicts the reaction's behavior?

options.A: The reaction proceeds in the reverse direction to form more reactants

questions.explanation: Excess products relative to equilibrium constant cause the reaction to shift left (reverse).

questions.question: What is the unit of $K_c$ for $PCl_3(g) + Cl_2(g) \rightleftharpoons PCl_5(g)$?
Which of the following compounds is an Arrhenius acid?
questions.explanation: Hydrochloric acid ($HCl$) dissociates in water to yield hydrogen ions ($H^+$).

questions.question: What is the pOH of a solution with a pH of 3 at $25^\circ\text{C}$?
Which layer of the atmosphere contains 75% of atmospheric mass and all weather phenomena?
questions.explanation: The troposphere contains the bulk of atmospheric air mass and water vapor.

questions.question: Which primary pollutant is an odorless, colorless gas that binds with hemoglobin to cause asphyxiation?
questions.explanation: Carbon monoxide ($CO$) forms carboxyhemoglobin, cutting off tissue oxygenation.

questions.question: Acid rain typically has a pH below:
questions.explanation: Normal rain is pH 5.6 due to carbonic acid; acid rain has $pH < 5.6$.

questions.question: Which metal ions cause hardness in water?
questions.explanation: Calcium and magnesium ions precipitate soap stearate as insoluble scum.

questions.question: Boiling removes temporary hardness of water by decomposing:
questions.explanation: Thermal decomposition precipitates calcium carbonate: $Ca(HCO_3)_2 \to CaCO_3\downarrow + H_2O + CO_2$.

questions.question: Clark's method utilizes which reagent to soften temporary hard water?
questions.explanation: Slaked lime reacts with soluble bicarbonates to precipitate insoluble carbonates.

questions.question: Which waterborne disease is caused by Salmonella typhi?
questions.explanation: Salmonella typhi causes typhoid fever through fecal-contaminated water.

questions.question: The anomalous maximum density of water at 4°C is caused by:

options.A: Collapse of hydrogen-bonded open crystal cage structures

questions.explanation: Between 0°C and 4°C, breaking of ice cages packs molecules more densely, peaking at 4°C.
